capabilities: open the right-clicked file or folder in the OS terminal
configure terminal executables or application names
extras: README is brief and points bug reports to an email address; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to open a file's or folder's location in a system terminal from inside the app.
summary: Context-menu plugin that opens the right-clicked file or folder location in the OS terminal, with configurable terminal executables.
